keystones.name: Juggernaut
keystones.text: Plant your feet and let them come: +70% defense, +15% max HP.

keystones.name: Berserker's Wrath
keystones.text: Every wound feeds the fire: up to +60% damage as your HP runs out.
keystones.drawback: -30% to your own heals and potions, -15% defense.

keystones.name: Glass Cannon
keystones.text: Your blows and spells strike 35% harder.

keystones.name: Blood Magic
keystones.text: Skills and spells cost HP instead of MP, and spells strike 15% harder.
keystones.drawback: Each cast takes from your health three tenths of the share of your mana pool it would have cost.

keystones.name: Blood Rite
keystones.text: Skills and spells cost HP instead of MP, spells strike 10% harder, and Soul Drain pays much of it back.
keystones.drawback: Each cast takes from your health a quarter of the share of your mana pool it would have cost.

keystones.name: Eldritch Bastion
keystones.text: Half of every blow you take is paid from your mana first, 1 MP for every 1.5 HP. +10% max MP.
keystones.drawback: Mana spent on blows is gone for spells.

keystones.name: Lich's Ward
keystones.text: Half of every blow you take is paid from your mana first, 1 MP for every 1.5 HP. +15% max MP.
keystones.drawback: Mana spent on blows is gone for spells and Soul Drain.

keystones.name: Faith's Bulwark
keystones.text: Two parts in five of every blow you take are paid from your mana first, 1 MP for every 1.5 HP. +20% max MP.
keystones.drawback: Mana spent on blows is gone for healing.

keystones.name: Stillness
keystones.text: Over a third of every blow you take is paid from your mana first, 1 MP for every 3 HP. +25% max MP.
keystones.drawback: Mana spent on blows is gone for your techniques.

keystones.name: Assassin's Mark
keystones.text: Critical hits deal x2.6 instead of x1.75.

keystones.name: Deadeye
keystones.text: Critical hits deal x2.4 instead of x1.75.

keystones.name: Martyr
keystones.text: Your class heal reaches the whole party, at 60% of its strength.

keystones.name: Grove Mother
keystones.text: Your class heal reaches the whole party, at 60% of its strength, and all your healing is 8% stronger.
keystones.drawback: Your class heal costs 50% more to cast.

keystones.name: Rooted
keystones.text: Sink into the earth: +60% defense, +10% max HP and +15% healing.

keystones.name: Fury of the Fist
keystones.text: Up to +50% damage as your HP runs out.

keystones.name: Diamond Body
keystones.text: Skin like cut stone: +70% defense and +12% max HP.

keystones.name: Last of the Line
keystones.text: The house will not end here: up to +60% damage as your HP runs out.

keystones.name: Elder Mind
keystones.text: Centuries of discipline: 35% of each blow that gets through is paid from MP instead (2 HP per MP).
keystones.drawback: Hard fights drain the mana your spells need.

keystones.name: Mountain's Heart
keystones.text: Stand like the mountain: +60% defense and +12% max HP.

keystones.name: Blood Fury
keystones.text: The old fury of the clans: up to +55% damage as your HP runs out, +5% max HP.
keystones.drawback: -20% to your own heals and potions.

keystones.name: Lucky Star
keystones.text: Born under a lucky star: critical hits deal x2.3 instead of x1.75.

keystones.name: Unstable Experiments
keystones.text: Untested, brilliant and loud: +30% damage dealt.

keystones.name: Dragon's Wrath
keystones.text: The wyrm wakes when you bleed: up to +50% damage as your HP runs out, +5% max HP.

keystones.name: Feral Instinct
keystones.text: Go for the throat: critical hits deal x2.4 instead of x1.75.
